description: Use before choosing what to fix: one list across audit failures, GSC striking distance and decay, cannibalization and competitor gaps. view=rank (default) returns the ranked list with kind/source/atStake/score and an opportunityId per row; view=library returns durable opportunity records filtered by status (open, snoozed, done, converted, resolved, dismissed), kind, limit and cursor for one site; view=detail returns one record with its action and event history (pass opportunityId). This tool is read-only: done/snooze/dismiss/reopen happen in the console, and propose_fix opens a review request.

limit.description: Max ranked pages to return (default 20, max 100)

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_opportunities
title: Read ranked opportunities and the durable library
